shared_command_root_worker_pin_multiplex.containment: The live supervisor runs from the immutable exact-merge root. The shared command root is kept at 894eb813 for new workers; the older owner worker uses the byte-identical scheduler rescue cut only while issuing its governed final status command.
shared_command_root_worker_pin_multiplex.description: Workers launched on either side of the command-root sync retain immutable per-run SHA bindings, so one mutable shared path cannot satisfy two historical SHA identities simultaneously.
shared_command_root_worker_pin_multiplex.expiry: When all workers pinned to pre-merge command SHA 88ace74d have exited.
shared_command_root_worker_pin_multiplex.recheck_trigger: Any watchdog restart, command-root sync, or governed status command from a pre-merge worker.
